rubric.correctness: 0: not checked; 1: material errors; 2: core checks pass; 3: handles edge cases and reconciles totals
rubric.reproducibility: 0: no artifact; 1: partial instructions; 2: another person can run/review it; 3: fresh run and malformed-input checks documented
rubric.interpretation: 0: no explanation; 1: unsupported interpretation; 2: population, units and assumptions clear; 3: explains decision tradeoffs and remaining uncertainty
rubric.independence: 0: contribution unclear; 1: copied with little explanation; 2: can explain and adapt the work; 3: independently diagnoses a new task variation

progress.interpretation: Completion records do not automatically change fit, proficiency or eligibility. Explicitly transfer assessed work to the evidence-review workspace and review it there.

objective: Maximize distinct reviewed gap importance covered by assumed training outcomes; then minimize economic cost (cash plus supplied foregone income if time value missing), then hours. Coverage is not proficiency or a predicted job outcome.

returns.reason: No explicit benefit input. Market wages are not substituted for benefits.

assumptions: Training skill outcomes, effort, costs and benefits are user-supplied scenarios; completion requires the stated artifact and human review.
Course prerequisites can be met only by confirmed prerequisites, direct evidence, or earlier selected training.
Preparation hours reserve time for verification, evidence translation and final review; course hours include their work samples.
Training cannot resolve an experience, license, authorization or degree gate automatically.
